records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total Net sales for the year ended December 31, 2022 increased $2,928 million, or 14.1%, to $23,749 million compared to the prior year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: All operating segments contributed to the Net sales growth.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: This decrease was partially offset by the absence of share repurchases and increased volume in our inventory financing arrangements.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in Gross profit margin was primarily driven by more favorable product mix and rate and higher mix of netted down revenue, as well as increased Net sales and margins on services as a result of the recent business acquisitions.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income was $1,735 million for the year ended December 31, 2022, an increase of $316 million, or 22.3%, compared to $1,419 million for the year ended December 31, 2021.
